plan.design_markdown:
# BW-17: LocalStorage and URL Hash Persistence for Panel Navigation and Sub-Views

> **Status:** Ready  
> **Parent Epic:** `BW-16`  
> **Target Scope:** `benchwork` (`benchwork/web`)  
> **Key Invariants:**  
> 1. Hard 250 LOC rule on all `.ts` and `.tsx` files.  
> 2. Client-isolated storage: zero backend database writes for ephemeral user viewport state.  
> 3. Seamless deep-linking: URL hashes (`#dag/kanban`, `#docs`, `#hub`) override or sync bidirectionally with `localStorage`.  

---

## 1. Overview & Objectives

Refreshing Benchwork currently causes disorientation because `App.tsx` and `DagBoardPanel.tsx` reset to default initial state (`activeTab = 'dag'`, `viewMode = 'dag'`).

BW-17 accomplishes:
1. Implements a robust `usePersistentState<T>` custom hook that syncs memory, `localStorage`, and optionally `window.location.hash`.
2. Persists active panel tab (`docs`, `dag`, `xray`, `hub`).
3. Persists sub-view mode inside `DagBoardPanel` (`dag`, `kanban`, `list`).
4. Persists filter selections (`statusFilter`, `kindFilter`, `includeArchived`, `repoFilter`).
5. Persists Benji assistant layout state (`isOpen`, `width`, `dockSide`, `selectedRole`).

---

## 2. Component Structure

```text
benchwork/web/src/
├── hooks/
│   ├── usePersistentState.ts  # Generic typed hook for localStorage + hash sync (<130 LOC)
│   └── useHashRoute.ts        # URL hash parser and dispatcher (<90 LOC)
├── App.tsx                    # Adopts usePersistentState for panel tabs (<220 LOC)
└── components/
    └── dag/
        └── DagBoardPanel.tsx  # Adopts usePersistentState for view modes and filters (<240 LOC)
```

---

## 3. Verification Steps

1. Select Panel 1 (Docs & Specs) -> refresh browser -> verify Docs & Specs remains active.
2. Select Panel 2 (Backlog & DAG) -> switch sub-view to Kanban -> refresh browser -> verify Kanban view remains active.
3. Switch sub-view to List -> filter by status "Ready" -> refresh browser -> verify List view and "Ready" filter remain active.
4. Open Benji sidebar -> set width to 500px -> switch dock to right -> refresh browser -> verify sidebar remains 500px on the right.
